criterion: 覆寫故障事件後，查詢仍反映持續故障；唯有擁有者依恢復條件更新才解除；重複故障不造成無界狀態增長，復原流程責任不與模組狀態混淆。
method: Model-assisted source/document review plus executable host regressions
finding: Reviewed rule/design contract case. Compliant example: A persistent fault remains queryable after its notification is overwritten; only the owner can clear it after recovery. Required finding for the counterexample: Queue removal clears fault state: ERR-STATE-001 failure.
limits: Rule/design governance acceptance; target runtime claims require separate project evidence.
